description: State transitions — All defined FSM transitions work correctly
steps: Define PetState enum with all animation states (idle, walk_left, walk_right, run_left, run_right, climb, fall, sleep, eat, play, drag, talk, happy, sad, curious, sit)
Define valid transitions per PRD Section 5.3
Verify transition: idle -> walk_left, idle -> walk_right
Verify transition: idle -> sit, sit -> idle
Verify transition: idle -> sleep (after 10 min idle or energy < 20%)
Verify transition: idle -> curious (cursor within 100px)
Verify transition: idle -> drag (user grabs)
Verify transition: walk_* -> run_* (cursor chase trigger)
Verify transition: walk_* -> climb (reached screen edge)
Verify transition: climb -> fall (reached top, random chance)
Verify transition: fall -> idle (landed on surface)
Verify transition: drag -> fall (user releases)
Verify invalid transitions are rejected (e.g., sleep -> drag)
Verify any -> idle catch-all default

description: Screen boundary collision — Pet doesn't walk off-screen
steps: Define screen boundary as window dimensions minus pet width/height
When pet position would exceed left boundary, clamp to 0
When pet position would exceed right boundary, clamp to screen_width - pet_width
When pet position would exceed top boundary, clamp to 0
When pet position would exceed bottom boundary (ground), clamp to screen_height - pet_height
Verify pet cannot move to negative coordinates
Verify boundary clamping works with movement velocity applied

description: Gravity simulation — Pet falls at consistent rate when released
steps: Define gravity constant (e.g., 980 pixels/s² equivalent)
When pet enters 'fall' state, apply gravity acceleration to vertical velocity
Each frame: vertical_velocity += gravity * delta_time
Each frame: y_position += vertical_velocity * delta_time
When pet reaches ground level, set vertical_velocity to 0, transition to idle
Verify fall takes expected time from known height (e.g., 200px drop takes ~0.64s)
Verify fall speed increases linearly (constant acceleration)

description: Cursor proximity reaction — Pet enters curious state when cursor within 100px
steps: Given pet is in idle state at position (400, 500)
When cursor moves to position within 100px (e.g., 450, 500) — distance is 50px
Then pet transitions to 'curious' state
When cursor moves to position exactly 100px away — pet transitions to 'curious'
When cursor moves to position 101px away — pet remains idle
When pet is not in idle state, cursor proximity does not trigger curious
Distance calculated as Euclidean distance between pet center and cursor position

description: Walk animation sync — Sprite frames match movement speed
steps: Start the app with cargo tauri dev
Pet enters walk_right state
Verify sprite frames advance at walk FPS (12 FPS per PRD)
Verify pet position changes each frame (movement speed ~60-80 px/s)
Verify sprite faces direction of movement
Verify animation frame rate is independent of render frame rate
Take screenshot showing mid-walk frame

description: Grab and drag — Pet follows cursor while dragged
steps: Start the app with cargo tauri dev
Click and hold on the pet (non-transparent pixel)
Verify pet transitions to 'drag' state
Move cursor — pet position follows cursor center
Verify sprite changes to drag animation if available
Release mouse button — pet transitions to 'fall' state
Pet falls with gravity until landing on ground

description: Multi-monitor crossing — Pet can walk from one monitor to another
steps: Start the app with cargo tauri dev on a multi-monitor setup
Pet walks to the right edge of primary monitor
When pet reaches monitor boundary, position wraps or transitions to adjacent monitor
Verify pet appears on the adjacent monitor at the corresponding edge
Verify pet can walk back to the original monitor
